title: The Broken Wreck
premise: Riverboat captain Emrys Thackeray fishes a sealed chest from the shallows of the Vell, stamped with the crest of Karvenia — a drowned nation whose treasury was lost when its last ship broke on the glacier-fed narrows forty years ago. The chest holds half a ledger naming every family the old regime robbed, and the salvage fleet's ruthless director, Corvane Hale, will kill to keep those names buried. Racing six tides ahead of Hale and the calving season that opens — then closes — the high route to the wreck, Emrys gathers a crew of castoffs who become the family he never had. At the wreck itself, Emrys must choose between selling the ledger's proof for his own pardon or giving it to the descendants it names; he chooses justice outside the law, scuttling his own boat to block Hale's salvage barge as the glacier calves and seals the route behind them.
about_author: Isandro Amberdale is a former deckhand turned novelist who spent a decade working inland waterways before trading river fog for ink. He writes adventure stories about people the maps forgot, drawing on the rhythms of water, weather, and hard-won loyalty.

chapters.title: The River Keeps Its Receipts
chapters.summary: Emrys Thackeray pilots his aging riverboat the Kindly Hour down the Vell, dodging debt collectors in the port of Sallow Bend. When his dredge snags a chest stamped with Karvenia's seal, he pockets it quietly, telling no one but his cook, Widow Ash. POV: Emrys. Beat: wary curiosity — luck finally arriving with teeth.

chapters.title: Half a Ledger
chapters.summary: Inside the chest: coins, a broken compass rose, and half a ledger listing families the Karvenian regime robbed before the nation collapsed. Emrys recognizes one name — his late father's. That night, a stranger offers to buy the chest sight unseen. POV: Emrys. Beat: the past stops being past.

chapters.title: Corvane Hale's Long Shadow
chapters.summary: The buyer is an agent of Corvane Hale, director of the Meridian Salvage Fleet, who has hunted the Karvenian wreck for years. When Emrys refuses to sell, Hale's men burn a warehouse as a message. Emrys realizes the other half of the ledger is at the wreck itself. POV: Emrys. Beat: fear sharpening into defiance.

chapters.title: A Crew of Castoffs
chapters.summary: Emrys recruits the only people desperate enough: Widow Ash, ex-salvage diver Tam Oriel, disgraced cartographer Nessa Quill, and a mute boy called Finch who reads water better than any pilot. They plan to run the high narrows before calving season opens the route. POV: alternating Emrys and Nessa. Beat: strangers choosing each other.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: The Kindly Hour races upstream against the tide clock while Hale's iron barge grinds after them. A sandbar trap Emrys knows by heart buys them a night's lead — but Tam reveals he once worked for Hale, fracturing the crew's trust. POV: Tam. Beat: loyalty tested by old debts.

chapters.title: What the Glacier Remembers
chapters.summary: In the frozen high country, Nessa deciphers her grandfather's charts: the wreck lies beneath the Serpent's Tooth icefall, reachable only during the brief calving window. An avalanche nearly takes Finch; Emrys pulls him out and the crew bonds around the fire. POV: Nessa. Beat: found family solidifying under pressure.

chapters.title: The Traitor's Tide
chapters.summary: Hale catches them at the narrows and offers Tam full pardon for betraying their position. Tam leads Hale astray instead, confessing everything to Emrys — including that Hale sank the Karvenian survivor boats forty years ago to hide the theft. POV: Tam. Beat: truth chosen over safety.

chapters.title: Serpent's Tooth
chapters.summary: During the calving window, Tam and Emrys dive the wreck and recover the ledger's second half — proof of Hale's crime and the full list of robbed families. The icefall begins to collapse early; Finch is nearly lost retrieving the compass rose that fits Emrys's broken one. POV: Emrys. Beat: triumph shadowed by cost.

chapters.title: The Scuttling
chapters.summary: Hale's barge corners them at the outlet. Emrys makes his choice: rather than trade the ledger for his own pardon, he scuttles the Kindly Hour across the channel, trapping Hale as the glacier calves and seals the route. Hale drowns clutching his claim papers. POV: Emrys. Beat: climax — sacrifice over self-interest.

chapters.title: Names Given Back
chapters.summary: Stranded downstream with nothing but the ledger, the crew delivers the names to the descendant villages along the Vell. Emrys buries his father's name at the riverbank, and the castoffs — now unmistakably a family — refit a salvaged hull together. POV: Emrys. Beat: resolution — justice given, home made, not found.
